rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a particular published version of a work.

example.english: This edition includes a lot of new information.
example.traditional: 呢個版本加咗好多新資料。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 baan2 bun2 gaa1 zo2 hou2 do1 san1 zi1 liu2

rows.note: Use this specifically for the number of copies printed in one run.

example.english: This reprint edition has a print run of only five hundred copies.
example.traditional: 今次再版嘅印量得五百本。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 zoi3 baan2 ge3 jan3 loeng4 dak1 ng5 baak3 bun2

rows.note: Use this for a particular occurrence or year of a recurring event, usually with a number or 今/嗰.

example.english: This edition of the book fair has many new books.
example.jyutping: gam1 gaai3 syu1 zin2 jau5 hou2 do1 san1 syu1
